projects.name: CineApi (Movie App Backend)
projects.description: Production-style REST API for cinema management with role-based authorization and seat reservations, built solo.
highlights: Cookie-based JWT authentication with three roles (Sys Admin, Cinema Admin, Regular User) enforcing fine-grained access policies
Seat reservations with business constraints (at most 4 seats per screening per user), plus movie, screening, and user administration
Layered architecture (Controllers, Services, Data) with EF Core, raw SQL migrations, centralized error handling, and a Dockerized PostgreSQL setup
